alpha_mask.mask_semantics: White/opaque pixels represent the estimated foreground; black/transparent pixels represent the estimated background.

method.name: rembg
method.note: This preserves the source character's pixels apart from automatic background-removal/alpha estimation. It is a full-character cutout, not separate hair, eyes or accessories.

quality_warning: Pending alpha-metric refresh; this historical warning should not be read as evidence of a poor cutout.
alpha_metric_definition: opaque_pixel_ratio counts alpha >= 250; this avoids treating rembg alpha 254 as transparent.
